concerns.text: Task T011b is marked as incomplete (checkbox unchecked) but is tagged [FR-001]. FR-001 requires the system to ingest ARC-Bench and output a labeled dataset. Without T011b being implemented, the core data flow for US-1 is broken, preventing downstream tasks (T013, T015b) from executing.

Task T015b is marked as incomplete (checkbox unchecked) but is tagged [FR-002]. FR-002 requires generating a rule library covering ≥90% of patterns. T015b validates this output. The missing implementation of this validation step leaves the FR-002 success criterion unverified.

Task T019a is marked as incomplete (checkbox unchecked). It is critical for US-2 (FR-004) to generate the experiment manifest. Without this task, the stratified sampling and experiment execution (T019, T020) cannot proceed, breaking the data flow for the comparative study.

Task T019 is marked as incomplete (checkbox unchecked). This task executes the rule engine on the manifest. Its absence means the core metric collection (Time-to-Pivot, Success) for US-2 cannot happen, violating the requirement to compare against the baseline.

Task T020 is marked as incomplete (checkbox unchecked). It is responsible for recording 'Time-to-Pivot' and 'Success Rate' (FR-005). Without this, the primary metrics for SC-001 and SC-002 cannot be generated.
Task T022 is marked as incomplete (checkbox unchecked). It merges rule engine and baseline results (FR-007). Without this, the paired comparison required for SC-001 and SC-002 is impossible.

Task T026a is marked as incomplete (checkbox unchecked). It outputs p-values for the interaction term required by FR-006 and SC-003. Without this, the statistical significance determination is missing.
Task T026b is marked as incomplete (checkbox unchecked). It determines significance (SC-003). Without this, the narrative conclusion for the research question is missing.
Task T029a is marked as incomplete (checkbox unchecked). It implements Tobit Regression for censored data (SC-001). Without this, the handling of failed pivots (censored data) is incomplete.
Task T029b is marked as incomplete (checkbox unchecked). It calculates stratified success rates (SC-002). Without this, the stratified analysis is missing.
Task T027 is marked as incomplete (checkbox unchecked). It categorizes failed pivots (FR-007). Without this, the error taxonomy (Coverage Gap vs. Distillation Error) is missing.
Task T027b is marked as incomplete (checkbox unchecked). It executes the taxonomy logic. Without this, the output artifact for FR-007 is missing.
Task T028 is marked as incomplete (checkbox unchecked). It ensures ground truth arbitration for taxonomy. Without this, the categorization logic is unverified.
Task T029c is marked as incomplete (checkbox unchecked). It executes the time diff test. Without this, the SC-001 metric is not generated.
Task T029d is marked as incomplete (checkbox unchecked). It executes the stratified rates calculation. Without this, the SC-002 metric is not generated.

Task T031 is marked as incomplete (checkbox unchecked). While tests are optional per the header, the task is explicitly listed under US-2 to validate rule matching logic. Its absence leaves the rule engine untested, which is a risk for FR-003.

Task T033 is marked as incomplete (checkbox unchecked). It updates quickstart.md. While documentation is often secondary, the plan implies a complete pipeline. Missing instructions for running the baseline (FR-004) hinders reproducibility.

Task T060 is marked as incomplete (checkbox unchecked). It implements the final orchestration script (code/main.py). Without this, the pipeline lacks a single entry point, violating the 'run-book vs implementation' consistency required for a runnable research project.
